notes.title: Important Announcement - Update/Future Plans
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,

We come to you today with a number of things to announce.  March 28th will come with an update that should make the game more accessible and help more players enjoy the game.  The following changes will be made:

[b]•	Removal of the Kuni Shop (No ability to purchase Kuni with real money)
•	All existing cash items will be put at a 50% discount
•	Cash items will be granted to players through daily attendance and daily reward systems
•	The required materials for all crafting will be reduced
•	Warlords Awakening (The Botimos DLC/Bundle) removed from Steam Store.[/b]

Along with these changes, we have some updates as to the future plans of Warlords Awakening.  Over the past months since launching, we have attempted to increase the number of players to ensure a better experience for our players.  This has not been successful from our end and we have decided to make some key changes.

It saddens us to say that by June 28th, 2019, we will be closing the service of Warlords Awakening.  Warlords Awakening will remove all in-game purchasing moving forward as the game is set to go to a Free2Play model on May 31st.  This is being done to ensure that we can gain more users to make the game more enjoyable for everyone involved.  By discounting the cash shop items, removing in-game purchases and granting more daily rewards, we hope that everyone who ever wanted to play Warlords Awakening will have the chance

notes.title: [08/10] - Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/90a1159dec8d9e78285410079ea5fe2058c42eff.jpg[/img]

Greeting Warlords

Today we want to bring you our plan for Warlords Awakening for both the immediate short term and our longer term updates and changes.  We have been gathering data over the past week to determine the best plan of action with regards to the changes and hope that you will stick with us in our journey to make Warlords Awakening the best gaming experience for you.

[h1]Development Roadmap[/h1]

We have broken down our roadmap into three timelines:
[olist]
[*][b]Immediate Changes (Throughout August)[/b]
[*][b]Content Update (End of August)[/b]
[*][b]Future Content [/b]
[/olist]
[b]1. Immediate Changes (Throughout August)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Item Crafting[/b] – Currently when you craft an item/weapon, Blood Knight and Guard is the default option for crafting.  This will be changed so you no longer experience this problem.

[*][b]Dungeon Keys[/b] – The tooltips for Dungeon Key materials will be updated so that the location of where to acquire these materials is added.

[*][b]Level 25 Quest Guide[/b] – After reaching level 25, an additional quest will be given that will guide you to the next zone, regardless if Kuntara is killed or not.

[*][b]Item Box Looting[/b] – We understand that opening each box individually has been an annoying feature of the game.  The update will bring forth the option to open boxes automatically when picked up.

[*][b]Costumes[/b] – Cosmetic costumes will be added to the Cash Shop.
[/list]
These changes will be implemented over the next 2-3 weeks before our larger content update toward the end of August.

[b]2. Content Update (End of August)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Raid Dungeons[/b] – Raid dungeons will be added.  After reaching level 40, they can be entered and raids will allow up to 8 man parties.

[*][b]Ranked Dungeon Mode[/b] – Ranked Dungeon progression will be added, and rewards will be given to the top 10 ranking groups on a regular basis.  This time interval is yet to be solidified.

[*][b]Gold Economy[/b] – We understand that there are currently issues with acquiring gold in game.  Modifying this aspect of the game must be done carefully as to not overinflate the amount of gold users can acquire, and then having to dial it back.  We are working on a number of possible solutions to make gold acquisition better and more enjoyable for our players.

[*][b]Boss Balance[/b] – We understand that many users have faced much difficulty leading up to and reaching level 25, especially with dungeons and bosses.  Hardcore users have been able to surpass this hurdle, but more casual users are having severe difficulty.  In light of this issue, we want to address some content for these earlier levels so that they can reach the end content for Warlords Awakening, but end content difficulty will not be changed. Boss balance for levels 25 and under will be modified. The difficulty of the “Secret Forest”, “Hidden Ruins”, and “Kuntara’s Hideout” dungeons will be rescaled with less attack damage to make it easier to complete.  Kuntara’s Hideout will also drop 2 unique items 100% of the time and Dungeon Keys will also be easier to obtain.

This method of keeping end game content difficult while easing up on earlier content for new users/characters will continue as the level cap is increased and more content is added.
[/list]

[b]3. Future Content[/b]
[list]
[*][b]PvP Updates[/b] – We have intents to add additional PvP content, but the exact details of such changes are not finalized. 

[*][b]Bug & Fixes[/b] – As the game continues to develop, we will continue to fix minor issues that cause inconveniences or problems while playing Warlords Awakening.
[/list]

We will of course keep you up to date with the exact changes and patch notes as they come.

Warlords Awakening Team

notes.title: Q&A #2 - Ambassador Test Period
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!

Our Ambassador test period is coming to an end shortly and we have received a great amount of feedback that we can begin implementing in the game as the first couple weeks of Early Access commence.  
We've decided to compile a list of some of the major issues that have come up that we are working to correct as soon as possible.  This is meant to be viewed as a Q&A and road map for what we intend to fix over the next couple weeks.

[h1]Ambassador Test Period Feedback[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]The chat font in game is not good.[/b]
We aimed to have a chat font that would allow many users from different countries to speak in their native tongue and have a font that would accommodate all players.  Our choice has clearly not worked well, and we will be improving it so that each language will look good in game.

[*][b]Lag issues[/b]
We've been aware of the lag issues some players have been experiencing, and most of the problems have been caused by having only a single test server located in the United States.  We have run a variety of tests with our Ambassadors and with the implementation of an EU server today, we hope to remedy these lag issues.

[*][b]Chat Censorship[/b]
The chat censorship has been quite annoying to many players and we realize it has caused undue problems. We do not need these over stringent censors in the game and soon players will be able to chat much more freely.

[*][b]VIP Service[/b]
There has been some initial misunderstanding about the use of this buff in game.  To those who haven’t played the game, it could be perceived as a Pay2Win feature.  We admit the labelling of VIP was a bad choice; the icon will be rebranded and the item will be named “Scroll of Awakening”.  This buff is temporary and is meant to help with levelling, and is given to players as attendance rewards, so every player can get the buff without paying any money.  So long as you play the game consistently, you will always have the helpful buff.

[*][b]Pay 2 Win[/b]
We have repeatedly announced and would like to say once again, that we strongly believe in a non-Pay 2 Win atmosphere for the game.  We have no intention to create any significant advantage for those paying money over players who don’t want to pay money in-game.
Warlords Awakening is a Buy 2 Play game and is priced at an affordable price, and players are not coerced to pay for anything extra to still enjoy the game.  There will be a cash shop with cosmetics and some consumables that provide a level of convenience, rather than advantage.  The cash shop will be updated over the next 2-3 days leading up to Early Access.

[*][b]Opening Multiple Loot Boxes[/b]
It has been very frustrating for players who are farming materials and items when they have to open each loot box individually.  This will be changed very soon so that up to 10 boxes can be opened at one time.  This should really speed up the process of farming and make the game feel more fluid.

[*][b]Epheia’s Blessing Bomb[/b]
While we thought this would be a quirky idea and it probably was for some players, we found that it is rather meaningless and exploitable to some degree.  This feature will be removed and readded once it has been modified to be more meaningful.

[*][b]Reward System in PvP[/b]
We are building a special reward shop for passionate PvPers.  We do not have all the details worked out just yet, but be aware that there will be great rewards and items that you can get if you want to be the best Warlord in Epheia!

[*][b]Stance Switching Delay & CC Breaking[/b]
In the current build of the game, there is a delay on switching your battle stance and many players have mentioned that this causes very clunky combat and detracts from some of the great, fluid combat that Warlords Awakening has to offer.  We do agree that the removal of this delay will greatly improve the quality of the gameplay and create a better experience for all players. 
The delay in stance switching has also made it very hard for players to break CC chains in PvP.  Without being able to switch stances while stunned, players are unable to use their escape abilities to break CC chains.  With the allowance of stance switching at all times, we will fix both of the above issues.  We ask that you do bear with us as this change will take 2-3 weeks to fully implement.

[h1]On The Horizon[/h1]

We're very happy with how the test period has gone and it has certainly helped us set up the game for Early Access launch.  With the additional feedback, it will also ensure that the game is more enjoyable for more players in the long run.  There are some issues that will not be perfected by Early Access launch, but we will be implementing them over the next couple weeks and the game will continue to get better and better.

Warlords Awakening Team

notes.title: Answers to Our Walords Awakening Q&A
notes.content:
Greetings all!

Last week we asked all of you what's on your mind, and we've hand picked a few of the most important questions to answer so that those waiting for Warlords Awakening can have their questions addressed.  

Lets get to it

[h1]Questions[/h1]

[i][b]"Will there be founder packs for the game that will offer exclusive cosmetics or other cool items?
We know the game will become available this summer is there a eta or just summer?" - Hisan[/b][/i]

Our plan right now is to offer a Founder’s pack exclusive to Early Access, and another package for full release with the same price point.  We may plan more packages at different price points, but none will be forced upon players to purchase.  We don’t want to say just yet what’s in store, but you can definitely expect the Founder’s pack from Early Access to have some exclusive benefits that is not included in the Full Release package.

[i][b]"Numerous people are wondering if the damage numbers that pop up when you attack a monster are going be the same as what we see of Kuntara Online? If so is there a option in settings to turn said numbers off? Also thank you for telling us it is P2P but with that another question comes in mind. Do you mean P2P as in buy the game once and have access to the game permanently or P2P as in have a monthly subscription where you would have to pay every month?" - San1992[/b][/i]

To address your first question, the game damage numbers that pop up can be helpful to users playing for the first time and create a certain aesthetic.  Having said that, we know it’s not for everyone and you can be rest assured, if you want to turn them off, you will have the capability to do so.  As for the business model, we feel it is much better to have people buy the game as a package so that they’re not hampered by required purchases in the game to keep up with other users.  That’s a very quick way for a game to turn Pay2Win and terrible for users who don’t wish to spend hundreds of dollars.  We have been in discussions internally and with our current Ambassadors about possibly adding a subscription for the game, but this is a careful balancing act between gaining and maintaining users, and earning enough to sustain the game for those users.  We certainly don’t want to drive users away because of the business model; we want to keep costs down so that everyone who wants to enjoy Warlords Awakening, will be able to.

[i][b]"In addition to the 6v6 MOBA style arena which we are very excited for in the future, several members of my community were interested in whether or not the team had thought about a Battle Royale game mode?

We were also wondering how many Ambassadors you were thinking of inviting and whether or not you will post an official list on your website?" - SoBaDStrange [/b][/i]

Great question!  We know there’s been a huge surge of battle royale type games over the past year or so, and while the idea is great, we don’t currently have plans to implement such a game mode.  But who knows what the future holds!

We have no exact number, but somewhere in the range of 50-100 should be suitable, and we’ll have programs for regular users in the future.  We will certainly be posting an official list when we have accepted the desired number Ambassadors from the first round of applications.

[i][b]"Are you willing to make drastic changes considering game play to suit player's wishes and needs?" - Spaz Rabbit [/b][/i]

There is a lot to digest here, but we think most of these questions can be summarized.  What is the new content we’ve brought and what changes have we, or will we make to the game?  
In essence, we have a road map planned for how to release the content we have currently have and are bringing forward.  And yes some of the changes you wish are included and some currently are not.  Depending on the success of the game and if we’re capable of sustaining a large enough user, you can expect more and more of what users want in the game, to be added.
As for events, the answer is yes, we will certainly have different celebratory events in the game.

[i][b]"If you guys are planning to bring it back from the ashes, can we expect the same game as we used to play before? 
I would like to know if this game being in your hands, can we expect it to live (for at least) more than 2 years?" - GalaxyEyes[/b][/i]

Hopefully the game will be stay to its roots and the great things from previous iterations can be coupled with the exciting balance changes we’ve made for the Steam release.  We feel as though we’ve taken the best elements the game has to offer and even improved them.  The longevity of the game is entirely dependent on the success we can generate.  With MMORPGs, a healthy user base is always needed to maintain the best game features. 

[i][b]"How frequent can we expect the cash shop to be updated since you guys have stated that the cash shop will be pure cosmetics?
Will the test server remain exclusive to ambassadors from now until the official launch in October? If not, how do you guys plan on recruiting more testers?
How long will testing last before EA & is there an estimated time-frame you guys provide us with after testing to implement any necessary changes before the game hits EA?" - Revanie[/b][/i]


The cash shop is meant to be updated frequently with changes so that the items do not go sale.  You can also expect a large amount of items to have limited releases.  Of what use is a cool pet or costume if everyone else has it?
The test server is currently only for Ambassadors pre-EA and pre big patch changes.  But all users who purchase a Founder’s Pack or obtain a founders pack key will be able to play the game during EA.  You will not have to wait until October to play.
Testing before EA is being done in house and Ambassadors will also have access to the server anywhere from 2 days to 2 weeks prior to EA launch.  The exact figures are not set in stone just yet.

[h1]In Conclusion[/h1]

A great big thank you to all that asked questions and a special thank you to those who we chose to answer specifically,  we felt their questions big summed up most people questions regarding the launching of Warlords Awakening.

The Warlords Awakening Team

notes.title: How Will You Choose to Fight?
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords Awakening Fans!

Let’s come together, all the Blood Knights, Mages, Hunter, Psychic and Assassins!  It’s time to talk about classes.  We want to take a minute to show off some great artwork and give some extra information on the classes available to play in Warlords Awakening.  

[h1]Blood Knights[/h1]

The Blood Knights are strong and well-rounded melee fighters.  They can offer massive protection, dish out steady damage or choose to slaughter enemies with a massive blade.  Blood Knights are always in the thick of the things and at the frontlines of every battle.  There is not another fighter that can take the place of Blood Knight in battle, as their skills are too valuable.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/09c32a3b26082509fd05fe273d8a120e7a1fcf72.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mages[/h1]

Balanced and trained in the elements, mages use their cunning to defeat their enemies.  Attacking from afar with fire, ice, or dark thunderbolts, Mages certainly cause havoc whenever they step onto the battlefield.  Their only weakness is attacks from in close…but you’d be lucky to ever get that chance.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/f78d4410daea9274d8d87fbf06aa6dd3ff4f8641.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hunters[/h1]

Hunters are highly mobile and know the lay of the land very well.  With traps, explosives, their long range weapons, they’re a mess for anyone to deal with.  Whether using their cannons, rifles, or bows, they’re capable of decimating enemies from afar without ever breaking a sweat.  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/c263ed768cdfa43352b493fe9fb99bedc6b14e4d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Psychics[/h1]

Psychics rest on the line between good and evil.  They have the power to channel Holy Spirit to aid and heal their allies, but also delve deep into the dark arts of sorcery to possess their enemies’ souls.  And if that wasn’t enough, they can communicate with totems if they so choose to.  Be wary of them, there’s no telling what a Psychic is capable of.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/cf9806feee3407096172cb9b70aad2755e89c2b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Assassins[/h1]

Perhaps the most mysterious of the classes, only the female Naru of Epheia can be trained as Assassins.  Swift, beautiful and yet deadly are their attacks. They will have their enemies silenced before they hit the ground.  Daggers, claws, and even an evil spell or two means death for anyone who seeks to challenge them.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982513/87ffc85edfcbe358b92346a47876af5de45713db.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoyed a little preview of the classes and the wonderful artwork we have to show.  Let us know in the comments what your favourite class is and why!

Warlords Awakening Team

The Warlords Awakening team
